items.title: VAST: Compiling Grounded Vulnerability Scenarios into Verifiable, Multi-Step Environments for Evaluating LLM Red-Team Agents
items.title_zh: VAST：将真实漏洞场景编译为可验证多步环境，用于评估 LLM 红队 Agent
items.summary: VAST is a declarative range compiler that separates vulnerability scenarios from a workflow-hardening layer, producing reproducible, multi-step environments for evaluating LLM red-team agents. In a budget-matched 270-episode prompt contrast, supplying the shared workflow protocol in full guidance lifts completion from 14/90 to 76/90 for glm-5.3, grok-4.7 and deepseek-v4-pro, and the main benchmark retains 1,387 instances.

items.title: BadGCL: Towards Persistent Backdoor Attack on Graph Continual Learning Systems
items.title_zh: BadGCL：面向图持续学习系统的持久后门攻击
items.summary: BadGCL is a model-agnostic framework for persistent backdoor attacks on graph continual learning, learning topology-aware structural triggers through a gradient mutual-information objective. The authors show that knowledge-preservation mechanisms can also retain early poisoned updates, and report persistent attack effectiveness across task-IL and class-IL protocols on four benchmarks with limited clean-utility degradation.

items.title: Real-World End-to-End Product Entity Resolution
items.title_zh: 真实场景下的端到端商品实体解析
items.summary: The paper evaluates four zero-shot product entity-resolution pipelines—lexical, semantic, hybrid-fusion and generative-lexical cascades—across established benchmarks, adding two real-world datasets characterized by cross-lingual noise and dense brand collisions. It compares lexical and dense blocking with cross-encoder, tensor-search and LLM verification on accuracy, runtime and memory consumption.

items.title: CLEW: Log-Anchored Backward Tracing for Root-Cause Code Localization
items.title_zh: CLEW：基于日志锚定的反向追踪根因代码定位
items.summary: CLEW combines rule-based log-to-code anchoring with LLM-guided backward code tracing, organizing observations into diagnostic states and returning ranked candidate functions with an affected module and an evidence-linked explanation. On the new LogLoc benchmark of 192 real-world issue and fault-injection cases it reaches 77.3% Acc@1 and 81.3% MRR on LogLoc-Issues, with wall-clock time about 73% lower than LocAgent averaged over all cases.

items.title: Keep it Simple! A Multiple-Choice Task can Benefit Generative Recommendation
items.title_zh: 化繁为简！多项选择任务也能提升生成式推荐
items.summary: The paper adds a multiple-choice auxiliary task to generative recommendation, synthesizing training data through task identifiers and candidate constructions so the model learns negative compositions and relative ranking signals. On four public benchmarks it improves TIGER's NDCG@10 by 4.9% to 79%.

items.title: InvarOrd: Self-Supervised Ordinal Knowledge Distillation with Rank-Invariant Alignment for Label-Efficient Cross-Species Hyperspectral Fish Freshness Assessment
items.title_zh: InvarOrd：基于秩不变对齐的自监督序数知识蒸馏，用于少标签跨物种高光谱鱼类新鲜度评估
items.summary: InvarOrd adapts a hyperspectral freshness model to a new fish species from 30 labelled cubes using self-supervised spectral pretraining, rank-invariant cross-species alignment and ordinal distillation into a compact student. The 423K-parameter student reaches 1.476 days MAE and 56.1% within-1-day accuracy on paired salmon and cod data, beating target-only training by 0.29 days.

items.title: Sada-ASR: A Production Multidialectal Arabic Speech Recognition System
items.title_zh: Sada-ASR：面向生产的阿拉伯语多方言语音识别系统
items.summary: Sada-ASR is the speech recognizer behind EchoNova's production Arabic voice agent; on a 120-hour test set covering Modern Standard Arabic and eight dialects it records an 11.69% word error rate, the lowest of twelve systems and ahead of Microsoft's MAI-Transcribe-2 at 13.51%. The authors also release a 20-hour subset of the test set with their scoring code.

items.title: Does a completed simulation run mean a usable urban wind result for AI agents?
items.title_zh: 仿真跑完就意味着 AI Agent 得到可用的城市风环境结果吗？
items.summary: UrbanWind-AgentBench comprises 200 tasks and 367 cases in 10 engineering task families, scoring deliverables and run provenance separately from numerical results recomputed against independent references. The WindPilot execution framework raises the number of OpenFOAM tasks earning numerical credit from 6 to 17 and full-score tasks from 0 to 3, with mean task score rising from 62.5 to 72.5.
